content:
maria: Heads up — sample-app failing in private deploy. SDK v0.12.1 returns 401 for embeddings with a priority param, but curl against the REST endpoint succeeds. Anyone seen a header/param mismatch?
kevin: Can you paste the curl and the SDK call you used?
maria: curl I ran:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-large","inputs":["a","b"],"priority":"high"}' \
  https://private.api.redwood.local/v1/embeddings
```
ashwin: And the SDK snippet?
maria: SDK call (node):
```
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-large', inputs: ['a','b'], priority: 'high' })
```
olivia: Hmm — two separate issues likely. SDK validation intentionally drops unknown top-level params to avoid surprising API calls, but for "priority" we expect it under requestOptions for reserved customers. That shouldn't cause a 401 though.
maria: Correct — the 401 turned out to be an auth header problem in private. SDK is sending `X-Api-Key: <token>` for private by default while our private gateway expects `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The public gateway accepts both, so curl using Authorization worked. Private shim is stricter.
kevin: That's a regression from the token-rotation changes? Which release introduced the fallback header?
olivia: Yes, regressed in 0.12.1 when token rotation codepath added legacy header fallback. Filed GH issue #8732. Workaround: set env `REDWOOD_AUTH_HEADER=Authorization` or explicitly pass header via client config.
ashwin: There's also a retry semantics mismatch I noticed: SDK auto-refreshes token and retries on 401, but for private that ends up generating multiple failed attempts and trips our circuit breaker. REST callers see a single 401 and handle it. We should not auto-retry 401 for private by default.
qa_tester: Repro in CI (steps): set REDWOOD_ENV=private, use an expired token. Results:
```
SDK logs: 401 -> refresh_token -> 401 -> circuit_open -> 429
curl: 401 only
```
olivia: Action items: 1) Patch SDK to default to `Authorization: Bearer` for private environments (kevin taking). 2) Add feature flag to disable auto-refresh-on-401 for private. 3) Update sample-app and quickstart to show priority under `requestOptions` and add a regression test for expired-token behavior in private.
kevin: I’ll take item (1). I'll open a PR with the header fix + a unit test. Need guidance on changelog wording.
olivia: Ping me on the PR. Add test in `tests/auth_test.py` verifying header and no accidental double-retries. QA, can you add a nightly regression case for the expired-token in the private smoke suite?
qa_tester: :thumbsup: Will add the test and a CI job to run the private shim smoke tests nightly.
devex-bot: New issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/8732 — assigned to kevin. Will deploy a canary patch tonight.
maria: Thanks — one last thing: we should document the param-shape difference for `priority` because a few customers have been hitting this drift in the sample app.
olivia: Agreed. We'll update the quickstart and sample-app to show: `client.embeddings.create({ model, inputs, requestOptions: { priority: 'high' } })` and add a short note about private header expectations.
maria: Awesome, thanks everyone.
